primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-polarized-RS-star (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 4318-4337

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the flat-lfp equivalence over the pushout descends the scheme, and the QCoh-flat modules equivalence over the pushout descends invertible modules, giving a Pic equivalence; the small point — that F' pulling back to invertible modules on X and Y' is itself invertible — is settled by finite presentation plus the fibre-wise invertibility criterion, the fibres of X' -> S' agreeing with those of X -> S; properness transfers both ways via base change and the thickening lemmas, and ampleness transfers both ways via base change and the relative-ampleness thickening lemma (source lines 4339-4407)
